name: linkup
description: Search the web and fetch page contents
long_description: Bring an API key from your existing Linkup account. Searches and page fetches use your Linkup credits. Saving, replacing, and testing a key only read credit balance and do not run a search. Only POST /v1/search, POST /v1/fetch and GET /v1/credits/balance are forwarded. Research and extraction jobs are not supported. Keep requests under the gateway's 120-second timeout.

examples.title: Search the web (uses your Linkup credits)

messages.403: Linkup key does not have access to this request
messages.429: Linkup rate limit reached or insufficient credits; check your account
